fusions.name: Fang Under the Rug
fusions.desc: Strikes with a venom dart that deals 7 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Slowed] for 4 seconds. Costs 4% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Coil and Spring
fusions.desc: Springs from a coil and bites for 13 damage, leaving the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds and 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds. The bite stuns it for 0.8 seconds.

fusions.name: Warm Side Out
fusions.desc: For 7 seconds, each debuff laid on you has a 55% chance to be sent back to whoever inflicted it instead.

fusions.name: Patient Venom
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition, your next spell deals 25% more damage. Once every 8 seconds.
